clusters.joint_reading: At main_sha the agentic loop DOES invoke the GH-36 equation phases: orchestrator.py:3027-3041 calls _detect_and_crop_equations and _attach_equation_latex_sidecars when --detect-equations/--recover-clean-equations are on (the memory that 'GH-36 never runs in agentic mode' is STALE at this SHA). But both flags default OFF, so the DEFAULT path is the native lane silently trusting math-font pages. The five issues split into two shapes: (a) default-path silent loss that ships regardless of flags — #140 (math-font pages trusted natively with no audit event), #165 (has_equations omits has_unmapped_math_glyphs so PUA-only pages bypass detection), #219 (_MATH_FONT_RE whitelist misses Palatino/PazoMath so those equations never yield regions); and (b) opt-in-path defects reachable only when flags are on — #157 (the 'no PageOutput' skip remains a silent warning) and #164 (full page native_text appended per rejected region, multiplying prose). None is dead code; all five are real, but (a) ships by default and (b) ships only to flag users.

All five are refactoring/architecture programmes with no runtime-behaviour change, and none is a user-visible defect — none should enter a fix queue. They differ in scope: #155 (split the ~5.5k-LOC orchestrator god-module into preflight/agentic_loop/legacy_tiers/…) and #174 (quarantine the legacy deterministic backbone, collapse dual implementations) are multi-PR programmes; #175 (break the tables<->benchmark 2-cycle by extracting a neutral module) and #176 (restore a dumb DocumentState blackboard with one authoritative page-text selector) are bounded single-deliverable refactors; #178 is a docs-only ADR (stay Python, no Rust rewrite).

These are the batch's real, testable defects in the fingerprint/manifest/replay provenance layer. #158 is the umbrella: model_version IS now populated in build_manifest from state.engine_runs and resolved_model_version (manifest.py:600-633), so the resume-invalidation half is largely done, but the 'default per-page provenance' half (rich journal fields written without opt-in manifest) is not. The four siblings are concrete holes: #169 drops the judge rejection reason for non-empty rejected attempts (orchestrator.py:2766-2767); #170 replay/stale_pages validate page text blobs but not figure/chart/equation assets (manifest.py:659-690); #171 terminal sidecars are flushed before _describe_and_embed_figures so they lack final figure_refs (orchestrator.py:4973 vs 5296); #238 the fingerprint records cfg.gemini_model, not which of the three _get_vision_engine producers actually ran (orchestrator.py:483, 5974).

None is a single defect. #39 (route-by-quality-per-dollar ladder programme), #49 (extract/verify/escalate architecture vision), #56 (CE corpus readiness programme) are roadmap umbrellas whose pieces land in later table/routing tickets. #114 (socr escalate subcommand), #202 (Mistral OCR 4.1 bake-off), #203 (consume Mistral blocks as priors) are proposals blocked on measurement or an external CLI fix (mistral-ocr-cli#23). #156 is doc-tracker hygiene (TODO.md/TICKETS.md stale vs closed issues), a bounded chore not a defect.
